purpose: NEO_R1_MODEL_V1 (NEO_R1_MODEL_V1_FREEZE.json) passed validation. This artifact documents why it cannot yet be applied to KB 2026090003's 118 R1-active players -- a distinct, later-discovered blocker, found only after the model itself was already frozen. This is not a model failure and not a data-recovery failure; it is a feature-availability gap at apply time.

the_problem.summary: NEO_R1_MODEL_V1's frozen features are pre_score (=NEO Ranking V1's NEO_V1_score) and r1_z. r1_z is computable for KB (its own official R1 evidence has real scores for all 118 active players). pre_score is NOT computable for KB.

why_pre_score_is_unavailable_for_kb.trace: NEO_V1_score's only source anywhere in this sandbox is content/website_v2/NEO_RANKING_V1_REDTEAM_BACKTEST.json (fields observations[].neo_score / neo_rank, joined into the Truth Warehouse by scripts/92_build_historical_truth_warehouse.py, line-verified: the join reads r['neo_score']/r['neo_rank'] straight from that backtest file's own pre-computed observations, it does not compute them itself).
why_pre_score_is_unavailable_for_kb.kb_not_in_backtest: NEO_RANKING_V1_REDTEAM_BACKTEST.json's events/observations cover only the 82 historical tournaments already in the Truth Warehouse -- KB (2026090003) is not among them.
why_pre_score_is_unavailable_for_kb.why_it_cannot_simply_be_computed_now: The NEO Ranking V1 model that produces NEO_V1_score is a SEPARATE model from NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2 (KB's actual live PRE model) and was documented earlier in this project's history as its own, still-unresolved effort (status BLOCKED_FORMULA_NOT_APPROVED in that separate thread) requiring point-in-time features the absent sqlite corpus computes. Re-deriving it for KB now, inside this task, would mean either (a) reusing a model formula that was never itself approved for production use, or (b) needing the same absent sqlite database already established as unreachable in this sandbox (KB_2026090003_R1_FEATURE_RECOVERY_V1.json, KB_2026090003_R1_MODEL_V1_RESEARCH_V1.json).

what_was_deliberately_not_done.no_feature_substitution: KB's own NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2 CUT/WIN/etc probabilities were NOT substituted in place of pre_score. They are a different quantity (already-combined tier probabilities from a differently-specified model, not the raw composite strength score the frozen coefficients above were fit against) -- plugging them in would silently change what the frozen coefficients mean, which is exactly the kind of unvalidated ad-hoc substitution KB_2026090003_R1_FEATURE_RECOVERY_V1.json's sign-inversion finding already proved is dangerous, not merely inconvenient.
what_was_deliberately_not_done.no_refitting: The frozen coefficients in NEO_R1_MODEL_V1_FREEZE.json were not touched, refit, or adjusted to accommodate a different feature set for KB -- the freeze rule ('after freeze: no KB-driven changes') applies precisely here.
what_was_deliberately_not_done.no_partial_application: No CUT/TOP20/TOP10/TOP5/WIN numbers were generated for any of KB's 118 active players using only r1_z with pre_score silently zeroed or omitted -- that would be a materially different, unvalidated model, not NEO_R1_MODEL_V1.

what_would_unblock_this: An owner decision to approve extending/running the NEO Ranking V1 model against KB specifically (a decision outside this task's authority -- that model's own validation thread is still open elsewhere in this project).
Access to the sqlite corpus (data/klpga.sqlite) this sandbox has repeatedly confirmed absent, which the NEO Ranking V1 point-in-time feature computation requires.

A NEW, separately-validated R1 model whose PRE feature is defined from something KB already has (e.g. NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2's own inputs) -- but that would be a different model requiring its own full walk-forward validation from scratch, not a substitution into this frozen one.
